module_summary: AXI-lite to APB bridge: three skid buffers accept AW/W/AR channels, an alternating write_grant arbiter picks read or write, and a PSEL/PENABLE sequencer drives one APB transfer whose result returns on B/R channels.

anchors.name: M_APB_PSEL
anchors.why: APB select; set when a read or write is granted, cleared on PREADY completion

anchors.name: M_APB_PENABLE
anchors.why: APB access-phase state bit; with PSEL forms setup/access sequencing

anchors.name: M_APB_PREADY
anchors.why: APB slave ready ends access phase and triggers AXI response valids

anchors.name: write_grant
anchors.why: Alternating read/write priority bit arbitrating AXI channels to the single APB bus

anchors.name: apb_idle
anchors.why: APB bus idle flag gating new transfer issue and grant updates

anchors.name: axil_write_ready
anchors.why: Accepts AW+W skid outputs and launches an APB write transfer

anchors.name: axil_read_ready
anchors.why: Accepts AR skid output and launches an APB read transfer

anchors.name: M_APB_PADDR
anchors.why: APB address loaded from read or write skid-buffer address

anchors.name: M_APB_PWDATA
anchors.why: APB write data latched from write-data skid buffer

anchors.name: M_APB_PWRITE
anchors.why: APB direction selected by arbitration; also splits response to B or R

anchors.name: M_APB_PWSTRB
anchors.why: APB byte strobes latched from write skid buffer

anchors.name: M_APB_PPROT
anchors.why: APB protection bits from AW or AR prot

anchors.name: M_APB_PRDATA
anchors.why: APB read data forwarded to S_AXI_RDATA via apb_data

anchors.name: M_APB_PSLVERR
anchors.why: APB slave error mapped to AXI BRESP/RRESP

anchors.name: S_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: AXI write response valid set when APB write completes

anchors.name: S_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: AXI read response valid set when APB read completes

anchors.name: S_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: AXI read data registered from APB read data

anchors.name: S_AXI_BRESP
anchors.why: Write response code carrying APB slave error

anchors.name: S_AXI_RRESP
anchors.why: Read response code carrying APB slave error

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Write address valid into awskd skid buffer

anchors.name: S_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: Write data valid into wskd skid buffer

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: Read address valid into arskd skid buffer

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: AXI write address buffered by awskd

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARADDR
anchors.why: AXI read address buffered by arskd

anchors.name: S_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: AXI write data buffered by wskd

anchors.name: wskd_valid
anchors.why: Write data skid output valid; gates write issue and PWDATA load

anchors.name: arskd_valid
anchors.why: Read address skid output valid; requests read arbitration

anchors.name: awskd_valid
anchors.why: Write address skid output valid; requests write arbitration

anchors.name: apb_bvalid
anchors.why: APB write completion pulse loading S_AXI_BVALID

anchors.name: apb_rvalid
anchors.why: APB read completion pulse loading RVALID and RDATA

anchors.name: apb_data
anchors.why: Selected APB read data feeding S_AXI_RDATA

anchors.name: apb_error
anchors.why: Selected slave error feeding BRESP/RRESP

groups.name: AXI input skid buffers
groups.description: awskd, wskd, arskd skid buffers registering AXI-lite AW, W and AR channels

groups.name: Read/write arbiter
groups.description: Alternating grant selects read or write when APB is idle and responses not stalled

groups.name: APB master sequencer
groups.description: PSEL/PENABLE setup-access sequencing driving APB address, data, strobe, prot

groups.name: AXI response path
groups.description: Converts APB completion, PRDATA and PSLVERR into AXI B and R channel responses
